name: The Purrfect Valentine
source:
Tired of spending Valentine’s Day alone? Or just tired of life and seeing happy couples isn't helping?

You don’t have to suffer alone anymore! After wishing on a star, Paris’ cat hero, Chat Noir comes to your rescue. How will the night turn out? It’s up to you how this [i]purrfect[/i] Valentine will go. Play [i]meow[/i] to find out!

[From [url=https://khywae.itch.io/the-purrfect-valentine]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
厌倦了独自度过情人节？或者只是厌倦了生活，看到幸福的夫妻也无济于事？

你不用再一个人受苦了！在向巴黎的猫英雄许愿后，黑猫来拯救你。夜晚将会如何？这个[i]purrfect[/i]情人节将如何度过，由你决定。玩[i]meow[/i]来找出答案！

[来自[url=https://khywae.itch.io/the-purrfect-valentine]Itch.io[/url]]
